judging_guidance: Do not require every conceivable deployment test before any provisional architectural decision. Full credit permits narrowing the next experiment to reconnect/backpressure and memory growth if its decision relevance is clear. Requiring unavailable hardware immediately and doing no analysis is incomplete, not safer. Judge environment/scope reasoning, not formal maturity labels.

criteria.description: Maps the target outcome to stream count, duration, memory bound, reconnect recovery and actual viewer; distinguishes architecture feasibility from release verification.
Explains exactly which prototype conditions are retained and omitted, and avoids extrapolating laptop loopback RSS/latency to board operation.
Uses the unbounded reconnect queue as a consequential design uncertainty and recommends a bounded next probe or design comparison that can change the architecture decision.
Gives a useful conditional commitment/reconsideration boundary now and a representative target validation path when access exists, without claiming unavailable measurements.

critical_failures.description: Declares the target 72-hour, 40-stream outcome verified or release-ready on the 30-second one-stream laptop result.
Treats exit code zero, a latency microbenchmark or endpoint RSS as proof of the deployment outcome.
Conceals or dismisses the supplied unbounded-disconnection-memory risk when recommending unconditional commitment.
